treatment.role: LSR-off arm of the llc LSR ablation
treatment.design: checked C model of the Typed row (01-row.c, hand-written, not Typed compiler output): each element access calls a capacity check that traps on failure
treatment.build: LLVM 18 llc -disable-lsr, from the same optimized module as the llc arm

provenance.note: curated from the attached study and capture sources; not read from the profile entry and not covered by source.digest

countsCover.role: LSR-off arm of the llc LSR ablation
countsCover.workload: one qemu-riscv32-static run of the linked executable per fixture row (fixtures/<y>.in on stdin); stdout must equal fixtures/<y>.gold
countsCover.counter: QEMU exec trace (-one-insn-per-tb -d exec,nochain); only PCs inside the nm -S range of symbol row are counted

totals.instructions.meaning: QEMU guest instructions executed with PC inside the linked row symbol, summed over the workload

totals.stackLoads.meaning: executed lw/lh/lhu whose operand text contains (sp), summed over the workload
totals.stackLoads.isNot: a stack-slot or spill count; byte, FP and copied-sp accesses are not counted

totals.stackStores.meaning: executed sw/sh whose operand text contains (sp), summed over the workload
totals.stackStores.isNot: a stack-slot or spill count; byte, FP and copied-sp accesses are not counted

rowBytes.meaning: bytes of linked machine code: the size of the C row symbol from nm -S on the linked executable
rowBytes.isNot: output bytes, the .gold file length, a checksum, or an execution count

samples.meaning: per-row totals for a few fixture rows, keyed by row index

rowsVerified.meaning: row inputs whose output equalled fixtures/<y>.gold

comparisons.isolates: LLVM backend Loop Strength Reduction: its net effect through the rest of the llc pipeline
comparisons.heldEqual: optimized module, contract, link, workload, counters; only -disable-lsr differs

cannotAttribute: an individual stack slot, frame offset or PC: totals and row samples carry no addresses (see q.joinPCs)
spill vs prologue/epilogue save vs local stack home vs scratch: the predicate sees only the base register sp
an individual optimization inside a treatment that bundles several changes
cycles or ESP32-P4 board time: these are emulator counts
trap-path behaviour: every workload input is a valid row
value.timing: emulator counts only; ESP32-P4 timings are a separate study layer, not loaded as a profile

reply.value:
Execution summaries: dynamic totals of executed work (not static sites). Sources: execution, typed, metrics (q: profiles.sources()).
  eager, values now:  profiles.arms()   profiles.arm("checked-gcc").describe()   .totals()   .samples()   profiles.workloads()   profiles.regions()
  lazy, use q.run:    .total(name)   q.add(…)   q.compare(…).  q.run(<a describe() descriptor>) returns it unchanged; see q.help("plans").
  q.run(profiles.arm("checked-gcc").region("row").workload("opening-160-rows").total("instructions"))
  stock = profiles.arm("typed-stock").region("row").workload("opening-160-rows")
  q.run(q.add(stock.total("stackLoads"), stock.total("stackStores")).label("direct stack accesses"))
Typed-summary entries are arms with the prefix "typed-" (typed-stock = typed["stock"]). Workload "opening-160-rows" is verified by rowsVerified === 160.
What an arm IS: profiles.arm("typed-scalar").describe().treatment → role, design, build, notA, provenance.
  Treatment labels are study/capture metadata (provenance.measured === false), not measurements; status "partial"/"undescribed" means the sources say no more.
  .describe().countsCover (treatment, workload, counter) · .fields (scope static|dynamic, meaning, isNot) · .comparisons (what a pair isolates) · .cannotAttribute
  .describe().units (one per total) · .sampleKeys (first 40) with .sampleCount and .sampleKeysTruncated; .samples() returns every sample
Totals are dynamic emulator counts: QEMU guest instructions inside the C row symbol, or RV32 interpreter steps for Typed. Neither is cycles or board time.
rowBytes is static: the nm -S size of the linked C row symbol, not output bytes or the .gold length. Typed summaries carry no code size.
Stack totals are direct sp-based accesses summed over the workload; they cannot be attributed to a stack slot, a spill, or one optimization in a bundled treatment.
Arms now: checked-gcc, checked-gcc-noiv, checked-llc, checked-llc-nolsr, checked-llvm, unchecked-gcc, unchecked-gcc-noiv, unchecked-llc, unchecked-llc-nolsr, unchecked-llvm, typed-pie, typed-scalar, typed-stock
